_meta.mode: Rounding.None everywhere, then per-prayer integer margin and rounding applied in the comparison
_meta.marginSearch: -15..+15 minutes, integer; a margin of magnitude 15 means the search bound was hit
_meta.fitted_at: 2026-11-10 (no clock read: every date comes from the data)
limits: 30 Ramadan imsakia days only, 2025-03-01 .. 2025-03-30: a single month, no annual extremum
Ramadan print: the sheet is an imsakia (imsak printed 5 min before fajr), not a year-round calendar
the sheet also prints 12 more cities; only Nouakchott is transcribed
_meta.reading: margins are minutes added to the raw computed time before the printed rounding; exact/within1/worst are per-prayer day counts; zeroMargin is the recipe as published with no margin and nearest rounding

imsakCheck.finding: the printed imsak is the printed fajr minus 5 minutes on all 30 days, so it carries no independent constraint
imsakCheck.note: fajr at 19.37 reproduces the printed fajr on 30/30 days, and imsak is that row minus 5
